  (hPosDef : A.PosDef) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hsmall : ↑(n + 1) * u < 1) (hcomputed : Cholesky.SuccessfulCholesky u A Rhat) :

      ΔA.IsSymm ∧
        Rhat.transpose * Rhat = A + ΔA ∧
          ∀ (i j : Fin n),
            |ΔA i j| ≤
              Cholesky.gamma (n + 1) u * (Cholesky.entrywiseAbs Rhat.transpose * Cholesky.entrywiseAbs Rhat) i j
def Cholesky.SuccessfulCholesky : {n : ℕ} → ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Prop :=
fun {n} u A Rhat => Cholesky.Execute u A (Cholesky.entryOrder n) 0 Rhat
def Cholesky.EntryComputation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ → Prop :=
fun {n} u A R i j value =>

    ∃ dot residual,
      Cholesky.SequentialDot u (Cholesky.dotInputs R i j) dot ∧
        Cholesky.Residual u (↑i) (A i j) dot residual ∧
          if i = j then 0 ≤ residual ∧ Cholesky.Rounded u (√residual) value
          else R i i ≠ 0 ∧ Cholesky.Rounded u (residual / R i i) value
